fatal_blockers: All six proposals presuppose an “actual” C_8, but the supplied evidence contains only an affine-detector surrogate and no hash-frozen U1 serializer. No proposed invariant or grammar has therefore been tested on the frontier family.

Proposal 1 lacks every required class-side branchwidth theorem, and faithful graph contraction does not automatically make the original represented column matroid a matroid minor of an equality-expanded matrix. A single F_2 tangle for C_8 cannot establish growth, survive characteristic artifacts, or exclude any of the four classes.

Proposal 2 has no defined toric-fiber-product width or proof that all four fixed-template classes bound it. Elimination of faithful auxiliary variables need not preserve indispensability, and Smith normal form supplies a kernel basis but does not enumerate circuits or test conformal primitiveness.

Proposal 3 is essentially finite-field matroid connectivity in tensor language. Balanced flattening ranks do not certify minimum bond dimension over arbitrary decomposition trees, while the four class bounds and preservation under projected equality gadgets are unproved.

Proposal 4's raw bounded torsion-profile premise is false in stated generality: repetition of a fixed local map such as [p] accumulates arbitrarily many p-primary elementary divisors. “Separator torsion-rank profile” is undefined, and deleting only eight columns of D_8 cannot repair the missing hereditary class invariant.

Proposal 5 leaves the boundary, legal continuations, and four grammars undefined. Its index can grow merely because the chosen boundary grows, so presentation invariance does not imply a template-constant class bound; minimizing one C_8 automaton cannot distinguish asymptotic U0.

Proposal 6 is the only direct frontier falsifier, but D_8 alone permits nonuniform decompositions and failure of bounded synthesis proves nothing beyond the searched grammar. Its optional bounded rebasing also does not resolve arbitrary unimodular equation equivalence, whose relevance must be fixed explicitly in U0.
evidence: The verified Generation-8 separator values 4, 6, and 9 concern surrogate affine matchings at three sizes, not universal-circuit factors, and are only top-level finite measurements.

The synthetic control verifies the operative row-basis warning: large displayed support subgraphs coexist with short kernel moves and a unimodular tree-incidence presentation. This specifically blocks support-only reasoning but does not validate any proposed replacement invariant.

Verify_support_minor_channel.lean proves only graph support embedding and a conditional branch-set minor for explicitly faithful equality expansions. It proves no column-matroid minor, toric elimination, tensor-rank, torsion, automaton, class-width, or U0 theorem.

The extensive signed, DROP, affine, carry, and Graver obstructions do not directly kill these proposals because they explicitly target U0 only. Conversely, none of these proposals advances U1–U4 soundness, recurrence, or the target gap.

Certified grammar synthesis can genuinely expose a fixed-class representation without promoting finite failure to a theorem, so Proposal 6 merits exactly one tightly bounded mutation; Proposals 1–5 do not presently supply a frontier-discriminating experiment.
